# Town of Manchester municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 14; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Manchester (official website), Selectboard page: 'Current Selectboard Members are: Ivan Beattie (Chair), Heidi Chamberlain (Vice Chair), Jonathan West (Clerk), Laurie Kunz, Jackie Wilson' -- the town's own page governs

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Manchester's selectboard as Ivan Beattie, Heidi Chamberlain, Cynthia Kilburn, Laurie Kunz, and Jonathan West; the directory is stale on the fifth seat -- the town page seats Jackie Wilson, elected June 2, 2026, and Kilburn no longer sits
Town of Manchester (official website), Elections page: the town-posted tally of the June 2, 2026 special election: Jackie Wilson 288, Rebecca Nawrath 200, Karen Dillon 84, Katie Stannard 78
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Anita Sheldon as Manchester's town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Anita Sheldon as Manchester's town clerk

Town of Manchester (official website), Boards page: the town's Board of Civil Authority listing styles Anita Sheldon Town Clerk; she is elected -- the Selectboard's June 9, 2026 agenda re-appointed only the Treasurer and the Constable

Town of Manchester (official website), Selectboard page: the Selectboard's June 9, 2026 agenda, item 8, 'Possibly Re-Appoint Patrick Owens as Town Constable and Brian Vogel as Town Treasurer' -- the treasurer is a Selectboard appointee

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Brian Vogel as Manchester's town treasurer (name concordant; mode is appointed per the agenda)

Town of Manchester (official website), Selectboard page: the Selectboard's June 9, 2026 agenda, item 8, 'Possibly Re-Appoint Patrick Owens as Town Constable and Brian Vogel as Town Treasurer' -- the constable is a Selectboard appointee

Town of Manchester (official website), Elections page: the town-posted tally of the June 2, 2026 special election: Douglas Kilburn 572, write-ins 9, for Trustee of Public Funds. The town labeled its post 'UNOFFICIAL ELECTION NIGHT RESULTS'; the Selectboard seated the same election's selectboard winner on June 9, corroborating effect. The prior holder was Sarah McClintock
Town of Manchester, 2022 Town Meeting Elections spreadsheet (certified): the 2022 Article 25 ballot elected a Trustee of Public Funds, establishing the office as elective with one seat
17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (elected town moderator, one-year term); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

Town of Manchester, 2022 Town Meeting Elections spreadsheet (certified): W. Michael Nawrath was elected Moderator in 2022 (813 votes) and held the office in 2024; the outcome of the February 28, 2026 floor meeting is published nowhere reachable, so no holder is minted
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists twelve Manchester justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024

Kunz, Richard M. Long, Charles 'Chic' Murphy, Rebecca 'Becky' Nawrath, Barbara Powers, Timothy E. Rhys, Anita L. Sheldon, and Thomas West.
